messages:
Alex: Hey team — small runtime/platform/infra/security ask. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/8372. This adds a rate-limit shim in the routing layer to short-circuit noisy clients. Tiny change but touches auth header forwarding and router middleware. Can @Jin (runtime), @Samir (infra), and @Mei (sec) please take a look? I plan to canary tomorrow at 10:00 UTC if we get LGTM by EOD. Diffs: ```diff\n+ middleware/rate_limit_shim.go\n+ forwardAuth := ctx.Header.Get(\"Authorization\")\n``` Thanks.
Tanya: I can own the canary stewarding if no one else has time. What failure-mode testing do we have and any rollback plan?
Jin: Skimming now. Two quick asks: 1) perf impact — can you run a small loadtest (seq len 32 and 256) and post p50/p95 token latency + error rate? 2) Does the shim touch KV cache keys or alter cache lookup path? If not, should be safe. Ping me with the benchmark link and I'll do a quick smoke.
Samir: Infra note — this touches routing config. Confirm envoy still forwards x-forwarded-for + Authorization as before. Any new secrets/KMS usage? If there are new secrets we need a brief KMS rotation/approval plan. Also flagging that integration tests flake on header propagation sometimes.
ops-bot: CI status for PR #8372 — unit tests: pass ✅, integration: flaky (1/3) ⚠️, e2e: queued ⏳
Tanya: Canary stewarding accepted. I'll schedule the canary at 10:00 UTC tomorrow and monitor /metrics/routing/rate_limit.{errors,latency,allowed}. If we see error spike > 0.5% or p95 latency +20% we roll back.
Mei: Security eyes — quick checklist: 1) Do we log auth tokens anywhere? 2) Are auth headers redacted in any new logs? 3) Does token forwarding semantics change (e.g., strip vs forward)? If answers are no / redacted / no-change, I can sign off; otherwise need a tiny patch.
Alex: Answers: we do NOT log tokens (we redact), no new secrets/KMS, shim does NOT change cache keys or modify token semantics — just short-circuits before routing on per-client counters. I'll run the perf scripts now and post results in ~15m. Thanks all — cc @Tanya for canary handoff. :thumbsup:
